import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import os

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
RANDOM_SEED = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_SEED)

# Define paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

print("Loading train data...")
train_df = pd.read_json(f"{input_dir}/train.json")
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")

print("Loading test data...")
test_df = pd.read_json(f"{input_dir}/test.json")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

print(
    f"Target distribution:\n{train_df['requester_received_pizza'].value_counts(normalize=True)}"
)

# Comprehensive feature list - ALL numeric columns + text
feature_cols = [
    # Text features (edit aware only per original)
    "request_text_edit_aware",
    "request_title",
    # Engagement metrics at REQUEST time
    "number_of_upvotes_of_request_at_request",
    "number_of_downvotes_of_request_at_request",
    "number_of_comments_at_request",
    "post_was_edited",
    # Requester behavioral features at REQUEST time
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    # Activity growth/change between REQUEST and RETRIEVAL (interaction signal!)
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_retrieval",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_retrieval",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_retrieval",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_retrieval",
]

# Separate features and target
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].values.astype(float)
ids_train = train_df["request_id"].values.copy()

# Separate test IDs
test_ids = test_df["request_id"].values.copy()

# Split training data into train/validation (hold-out) - VALIDATION USED FOR EVALUATION ONLY
X_train_fold, X_val, y_train_fold, y_val, ids_train_fold, ids_val = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    ids_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=RANDOM_SEED,
    stratify=y_train,
)

# Fill NaN values consistently
X_train_fold = X_train_fold.fillna(-1)
X_val = X_val.fillna(-1)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].fillna(-1)

# Extract text separately for TF-IDF
train_text_edit = X_train_fold["request_text_edit_aware"]
train_title = X_train_fold["request_title"]
val_text_edit = X_val["request_text_edit_aware"]
val_title = X_val["request_title"]
test_text_edit = test_df["request_text_edit_aware"]
test_title = test_df["request_title"]

# Combine text and title into single text array for TF-IDF
train_text_combined = train_text_edit + " " + train_title
val_text_combined = val_text_edit + " " + val_title
test_text_combined = test_text_edit + " " + test_title

# TF-IDF vectorization for text features
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=3000, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2), lowercase=True
)
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(train_text_combined)
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(val_text_combined)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_text_combined)

# Prepare numeric features only (excluding text columns)
numeric_feature_cols = [
    c for c in feature_cols if c not in ["request_text_edit_aware", "request_title"]
]

X_train_numeric = X_train_fold[numeric_feature_cols].values
X_val_numeric = X_val[numeric_feature_cols].values
X_test_numeric = X_test[numeric_feature_cols].values

# Scale numeric features
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled_numeric_train = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_numeric)
scaled_numeric_val = scaler.transform(X_val_numeric)
scaled_numeric_test = scaler.transform(X_test_numeric)

# Concatenate all features
X_train_combined = np.hstack([scaled_numeric_train, X_train_tfidf.toarray()])
X_val_combined = np.hstack([scaled_numeric_val, X_val_tfidf.toarray()])
X_test_combined = np.hstack([scaled_numeric_test, X_test_tfidf.toarray()])

# Train Random Forest on training folds only (NOT including validation)
print("Training Random Forest...")
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=20,
    min_samples_leaf=3,
    random_state=RANDOM_SEED,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=False,
)
model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train_fold)

# Validate on hold-out set (data NOT used for training)
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
auc_roc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"AUC-ROC Validation: {auc_roc_val:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Create submission DataFrame matching sample format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_ids, "requester_received_pizza": test_preds}
)

# Save submission to required location
submission.to_csv(f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_dir}/submission.csv")

# Print only the evaluation metric as required
print(f"{auc_roc_val:.6f}")
